description: The do not breed event records an observation that an animal has been assigned not to be bred. There are no other parameters.

doNotBreed.description: Set this attribute to true if the animal should not be bred, false if it may now be bred.

reason.description: Identifies the reason for not breeding the animal (very similar to departure reasons, hence same code list).

extendedReasons.description: Extended reason codes why this animal should not be bred.

diagnosisCode.description: Used with 'Health' reason to expand on health reasons for not breeding. Use ICAR (https://www.icar.org/guidelines/icar-central-health-key/) or VENOM coding scheme.
